excerpt: Eastman's minimalist writing lends itself to reinterpretation and reorganization. Many of his pieces are constituted as overlapping patterns of cells to which lines can be added or from which they can be removed. The album takes the classical tradition's decorum and mutilates it into something furious and alive. Bravo.

Ava Mendoza is simply one of the best guitarists around today. She has played with a murderer's row of improvisers and experimentalists over the last 20 years. These are matter-of-fact guitar heroics without any sense of ego. Or restraint.
